p.THE-PROJECT-KEEPS-A-SECOND-TEST-TIER: This project keeps a **second test tier**: human-run markdown walkthroughs that prove the integration surfaces the automated suite cannot reach.

p.THE-AUTOMATED-TIER-PROVES-THE-LOGIC-THE-: The automated tier proves the logic; the manual tier proves the world.

p.THE-MANUAL-TIER-COMPLEMENTS-AND-NEVER-RE: It complements the automated suite — it never replaces it.

p.propose-a-manual-test-lead: Propose a manual test — do not wait to be asked — whenever:

item.TRIGGER-A-NEW-INTEGRATION-SURFACE-LANDS: **A new integration surface lands.** Real authentication, the per-user state directory on a real filesystem, a lockfile as a downstream consumer sees it, network-facing I/O — anything the automated tier fakes now has a real-world form that nothing proves.

item.TRIGGER-A-MILESTONE-APPROACHES: **A milestone approaches.** Before tagging, every run the index marks required for the shipped features must have been executed.

item.TRIGGER-A-USER-REPORTS-AN-INTEGRATION-BU: **A user reports an integration bug.** Its reproduction steps become a manual test, so the next session can replay them exactly.

p.sibling-document-pointers: The format, authoring rules, and copy-ready skeleton live under @spec://org.vibevm.world/manual-tests/flows/manual-tests/MANUAL-TESTS-PROTOCOL#root.

p.the-whole-point-is-human-eyes-on-real-ou: The whole point of the tier is human eyes on real output.

p.AN-AGENT-MAY-PRE-RUN-AND-FLAG-DIVERGENCE: An agent may **pre-run** a manual test end to end and flag any step whose result diverges from its "Expected" paragraph — that is useful triage.

p.THE-SIGN-OFF-IS-A-HUMANS: But the sign-off is a human's: only a person can look at the tool's output and say "yes, that is what I meant".

p.REPORT-THE-PRE-RUN-NEVER-RECORD-THE-PASS: Report the pre-run; never record the pass.

item.NEVER-LET-A-MANUAL-TEST-TOUCH-REAL-USER-: **Never let a manual test touch real user state.** Every run isolates its project into a scratch directory and redirects the tool's per-user cache into that scratch. A test that mutates the real per-user state is a bug in the test.

item.NEVER-WRITE-A-STEP-WITHOUT-AN-EXPECTED-P: **Never write a step without an "Expected" paragraph.** A command with no stated outcome cannot pass or fail; it is not a test step.

item.NEVER-TAG-A-MILESTONE-WITH-REQUIRED-RUNS: **Never tag a milestone with the index's required runs unexecuted.** Green automated suite plus unrun manual tests is not a shippable milestone.

item.NEVER-DELETE-A-FAILING-MANUAL-TEST-TO-MA: **Never delete a failing manual test to make the panel green.** A test that caught something is working; file what it caught and fix the product, not the test.
